## Outcome

Describe the user/runtime outcome and the owning subsystem.

## Source of truth

List the contract, issue, ADR, or external integration used as authority.

## Verification

List exact commands and results. Distinguish unit/static proof from real
end-to-end behavior and state what was not verified.

## Boundary and safety

- [ ] No credentials, private data, runtime state, or unsanitized artifacts.
- [ ] Framework/product ownership remains explicit.
- [ ] Failures do not silently fall back or masquerade as success.
- [ ] Relevant documentation owners and changelog entries are updated.
- [ ] New or changed dependencies were researched and approved.
